interactions.note: The affinity of Fab/EE for the epitope-tagged maltose binding protein was determined by surface plasmon resonance. The affinity of Fab/EE for binding to MBP containing a C-terminal (MBP-EE) or an internal (MBP-KEE) EE peptide was KD = 308 nM and KD = 612 nM, respectively. The affinity for an scFv with the EE peptide inserted into the flexible linker region (scFv-EE1) was KD = 224 nM. No significant affinity loss was observed upon conversion of the scFv format to a Fab (KD =767 nM for scFv/EE binding to MBP-EE). The affinity of Fab/EE for the EE peptide flanked by flexible linkers (sequence GS-EYMPME-GS) inserted into the N-terminal segment of ICL3 of an A2aR-green fluorescence protein (A2aR-GFP-EE) was KD = 32 nM.

The affinity of Fab/EE for the epitope-tagged maltose binding protein was determined by surface plasmon resonance. The affinity of Fab/EE for binding to MBP containing a C-terminal (MBP-EE) or an internal (MBP-KEE) EE peptide was KD = 308 nM and KD = 612 nM, respectively. The affinity for an scFv with the EE peptide inserted into the flexible linker region (scFv-EE1) was KD = 224 nM. The epitope-specific Fab/EE formed a stable complex with maltose binding protein containing an internal EE peptide, as demonstrated by size exclusion chromatography. Fab/EE also formed a stable complex with the β-barrel membrane protein, E. coli intimin containing an internal EE peptide, as demonstrated by size exclusion chromatography.
